prompt: Beneath an ocean reef, shafts of light illuminate schools of tropical fish darting among colorful corals. A cluster of anemones sways next to a sea turtle gliding past a group of five starfish clinging to a rock. A pair of hermit crabs scuttle over the sandy bottom beside a sunken wooden chest encrusted with barnacles. A garden of bright sponges and tube worms grows near a swaying kelp forest where seahorses drift in the current. A conch shell lies half-buried beside a clam shell and a glass bottle caught in the sand. Nearby, a sea urchin hides under a piece of driftwood, and a school of jacks flashes silver beneath the waves. There is no scuba diver, no submarine, no plastic bag, no oil slick, and no fishing net.
